summary: Frontend re-verification of the two bugs found in iteration_18 for Phase Predictor dynamic clinical cycle model. BOTH BUGS FIXED. (1) Reference cards now render 'Days X-Y' from computePhaseBoundaries.ranges — verified all 5 cards show correct ranges for default 28/5/14 (M 1-5, F 6-12, O 13-15, L 16-24, PMS 25-28). (2) Prediction now recomputes reactively when Advanced Settings change without needing to clear/re-pick the date — verified by picking a date landing on cycle Day 17, which showed Luteal at lutealConstant=14 then instantly switched to Ovulation after changing lutealConstant to 11 (no re-pick). Reference cards also update reactively (Ovulation card range moved from 13-15 to 16-18 after the change). Advanced Settings still persist to localStorage under cyclecoach_cycle_settings_<uid> and rehydrate on reload. computePhaseBoundaries math re-verified for all required cases: 24/5/14 -> F 6-8 / O 9-11, 35/5/14 -> F 6-19 / O 20-22, 28/5/14 -> F 6-12 / O 13-15 / L 16-24 / PMS 25-28.
critical_code_review_comments: cycleCalculations.js computePhaseBoundaries still has the pre-existing pmsLength inconsistency for lutealConstant=15/16 (pmsLength=6 but ranges.pms may be 5 days). Not in scope of this iteration but worth revisiting.
PhasePredictor.jsx uses require('./phaseContent') inside getPhaseInfo (cycleCalculations.js line 165) — mixed ESM/CJS; consider converting to a static import for tree-shaking and consistency.

Prediction is now derived inline as `const prediction = predictionDate ? calculatePrediction(predictionDate) : null` (line 116), so it recomputes on every render when either predictionDate or cycleSettings changes.
